description: Describes the transport parameters of a Sender of urn:x-padl:transport:ieee1722, an IEEE 1722 talker stream (a STREAM_OUTPUT of an IEEE 1722.1 entity; Milan is the profile presented). They are the talker's identity a listener is bound to it by; the Sender reports them and they are fixed at the constraints endpoint. IEEE 1722 Senders must support all parameters in this schema.
title: IEEE 1722 Sender Transport Parameters

entity_id.description: Entity ID of the talker as IEEE 1722.1 writes an EUI-64: 16 hexadecimal digits, optionally prefixed by 0x. Senders report 16 lowercase digits; a Receiver also accepts fewer digits, with leading zeros left out. A null value indicates that the Sender does not know its talker identity.

stream_index.description: Index of the talker's STREAM_OUTPUT descriptor. A null value indicates that the Sender does not know its talker identity.
